title: Raiders at the Ford
text: Deserters from some dead lord's army have taken the ford, hanging their tolls from a gibbet by the water. They tax every cart that crosses, in coin or in blood. The militia needs arms and pay before it will march against them.

temptation.label: Pay the raiders' captain for safe passage of your own carts.
temptation.text: Cheaper than a war, and no one need know.

triumph.text: The ford is cleared and the deserters hang from the old bridge.

holds.text: The raiders melt away into the hills.

falters.text: The raiders burn a mill before they go.

calamity.text: The raiders sack the outer farms and ride off rich.
